resources.string: Seven roles carry every screen. The values below are read from the theme in use.
Four colours that mean something. They colour words and icons; only the primary and destructive buttons and the badge are filled with them.
This list will be deleted for good.
The backup is nine days old.
Saved. Everything is up to date.
Five glazes are poured into recessed beds. Each bed shows its colour in this theme, with a label resting on it.
A track with ordered options takes its glazes from the scale: warm at the start, cool at the end.
Move a thumb to see what it reports.
Drag a thumb slowly and watch one glaze blend into the next.
When the options have no order, one glaze under all of them says so.
The same switch and track in both themes, each on its own canvas. Move one and its twin follows.

The neutral and semantic values, the five glazes and the two, three and four step scale were extracted from the original app; only warning was darkened for the light theme. The role names, one glaze for a plain choice, scales of any length and the glaze kept in night tracks were designed for Sancai.
